title: Write test stand-in scripts via one helper that avoids ETXTBSY
summary: Add one shared test-support crate with a helper that writes an executable stand-in script safely (temp name, close, chmod, rename) and a run helper that retries on ETXTBSY. Switch every listed test to it. The audience is the maintainers, whose jobs get rejected by flaky tests.

defaults_applied.how: Stress test added; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Criterion runs helper under concurrent forks and checks no ETXTBSY.
One focused change to the helper and call sites.
Doc comments explain the ETXTBSY cause.
Verifier runs cargo test, clippy, fmt --check.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs (stand_in ~638), crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs (~998), crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs (~8141), crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs (~513), crates/athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs (~140), xtask/src/main.rs (stand_in_claude ~833), and the crates' Cargo.toml files. No records or data files are added, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are unaffected. The ETXTBSY property is measured directly by a stress test that runs the helper's script while other threads fork, not through a stand-in.

athena-git has no athena dependencies and the other crates differ in their graphs, so a shared helper needs a new small workspace crate (e.g. crates/athena-testutil) used as a dev-dependency by athena-agent, athena-core, athena-git, athena-cli and xtask. This adds the crate to the workspace Cargo.toml members and workspace dependencies. Alternative of reusing the athena-core test-support feature is rejected because athena-git and athena-agent cannot depend on core.
Non-test snapshot/pin code that sets permissions on materialised files is out of the pattern (no run-at-once) and stays unchanged.

Helper API: write_executable(path, contents) writes to a temp name in the same dir, drops the handle, chmods, renames; and a retry wrapper for Command runs that retries on raw_os_error ETXTBSY (26) a few times with a short sleep. Tests that spawn through Command use the wrapper where practical.

acceptance_criteria.text: A single shared helper (new crate under crates/, listed in workspace Cargo.toml and as a dev-dependency) writes executable scripts via temp file, close, chmod, rename; Grep shows no remaining write-then-from_mode(0o755) stand-in pattern in xtask/src/main.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs, crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs, crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs, crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs tests.

A stress test in the helper crate writes and runs scripts many times (e.g. 200) while other threads repeatedly fork/spawn processes, and every run succeeds with no ETXTBSY; run `cargo test` and it passes.
All existing tests still pass: `cargo test --workspace` passes and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing only what the diff does (shared stand-in helper, listed tests moved onto it, ETXTBSY retry, stress test), with no unrelated claims.

The helper has doc comments explaining the ETXTBSY cause for an outside reader, and the diff touches only the helper crate, workspace/dev-dependency manifests, the listed tests, Cargo.lock and CHANGELOG.md.

out_of_scope: Non-test code that materialises files with permissions (pin.rs, snapshot.rs non-test code, toolconfig.rs)
departures: Touches six crates plus a new workspace crate, so cost and time are above the reference.
urgent_reason: Removes flaky ETXTBSY test failures that reject correct jobs, cutting failed attempts and redo work.
